project.title: Dynamic membrane bioreactor performance enhancement by PAC addition: evaluation of sludge morphological, aggregative and microbial properties
project.description: The effects of powdered activated carbon (PAC) at 1 g/L on the sludge morphological, aggregative and microbial properties in a dynamic membrane bioreactor (DMBR) were evaluated to determine the mechanism of performance enhancement.
project.center_name: Xi`an University of Architecture and Technology
